default_prompt:
Extract every mention of these entity types:
- chemical: a chemical compound, element or drug (e.g. "aspirin", "glucose", "sodium chloride").
- disease: a disease or disorder (e.g. "rheumatoid arthritis", "type 2 diabetes", "asthma").
- gene: a gene or protein, by name or symbol (e.g. "BRCA1", "tumor necrosis factor", "insulin receptor").
- food: a food, dish or ingredient (e.g. "apple", "whole milk", "olive oil").
- other: any other notable named entity, such as an organism, person, place or organisation (e.g. "Escherichia coli").

Rules:
- Copy each mention exactly as written in the text, with its spelling, case and punctuation; do not correct, expand or normalise it.
- Each occurrence is its own entity: a mention that appears twice is listed twice.
- Mentions must not nest or overlap: when one contains another, keep only the longer (e.g. "rheumatoid arthritis", not also "arthritis").
- Extract at most 25 entities.
